# X-traordinary Development

> The development team for companies that don't have one. Custom, AI-native software for mid-sized companies (200 to 2,000 people) in non-tech industries that have an IT leader but no developers, built inside their own Microsoft and Azure environment. Minneapolis, MN and Miami, FL. Black-owned. Founded and led by Xavier Thurman.

We build assistants over a company's own documents, research and intelligence feeds, document generation from company data, workflow automation with a person in the loop, integrations and dashboards, and internal applications. Everything runs in the client's tenant; the client owns the code and the data. We no longer build websites.

Contact: xavier.thurman@x-traordinarydevelopment.com, +1 763-742-4823, https://x-traordinarydevelopment.com/contact.html

## How we work

- [What we build](https://x-traordinarydevelopment.com/services.html): the three offers. (1) AI-Native Assessment and First Build, $15,000 to $25,000 fixed, 4 to 6 weeks: two weeks of discovery, a ranked roadmap, one working tool. (2) Retained Development Function (Run / Build / Advise), $10,000 to $20,000 a month on a 12-month term. (3) Fixed-price projects, $30,000 to $50,000.
- [Custom software development in Minneapolis](https://x-traordinarydevelopment.com/custom-software-development-minneapolis.html)
- [Start with an assessment](https://x-traordinarydevelopment.com/contact.html): a 30-minute call first, then a two-page scope the next day.

## Who it is for

IT Directors, CIOs, COOs and CFOs at engineering and construction, agriculture and co-op, manufacturing, distribution, professional-services and regional healthcare companies with 200 to 2,000 employees and no in-house developers, usually on Microsoft 365 and Azure with a managed IT provider for infrastructure. Not small businesses, not startups, not website buyers.

## Proof

- Currently the entire development function for a 1,000-person Minnesota engineering firm, including an AI research-and-document platform in the firm's Azure tenant.
- Internal applications at U.S. Bank and CHS Inc.
- Shipped products of our own, including GridLink (procurement) and Nouri (coaching).
- [Previous work](https://x-traordinarydevelopment.com/previous-work.html)
